definitions.short: Mica , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H4316. Mika מִיכָא proper name, masculine (so in Palmyrene, Vog No. 36a ). 1 son of Mephibosheth ( ᵐ5 Μειχα ), 2Sam 9:12 ( = מִיכָה 4 ) 2 Neh 10:2 . 3 Neh 11:7 ( = 1Chr 9:15 ), 9:22 (called מִיכָיָה 12:35 ).

occurrences.englishText: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All that lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.
and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of God’s house.
